<question>
I returned the keys of my flat in Spain two months ago and my landlord has still not returned my deposit. Does he owe me interest?
</question>

<answer>
Yes. The balance of the cash deposit (fianza) that must be returned to the tenant at the end of a lease accrues the legal interest. [1] This applies once one month has passed since the tenant handed over the keys without the refund having been made. [1]
</answer>

<reference>
Yes. The balance of the cash deposit (fianza) that must be returned to the tenant at the end of the lease accrues the legal interest once one month has passed since the tenant handed over the keys without the refund having been made (art. 36.4 of the Ley de Arrendamientos Urbanos).
</reference>
